purpose: Qualify a transaction-safe finite-time dry-to-ponded boundary event for real soil physics without repeated event-search trajectories. After an initially dry-admissible interval is predicted to cross complementarity, solve event time and event soil state together, then continue the remainder under ponded/head mode. Publish only one final atomic interval commit.

domain_controls.B12_O13: R2A remains authoritative: 0.995 KSAT is no-event and 1.005 KSAT is immediate R1 at the prior committed profile. R2 shall not manufacture a finite-time event for these materials.

frozen_geometry_and_scope.forcing: constant q_supply over the entire interval

transactional_algorithm.step_1_initial_admission: At t0 evaluate qcap0 at h_surface=0 from the committed top-node state. Require q_supply<qcap0 beyond roundoff, proving this is not an R1 immediate event.
transactional_algorithm.step_2_predictor: Solve one full-interval dry-flux trial with q_top=q_supply from the original committed state. This predictor is never committed. Require its endpoint to indicate that dry complementarity no longer admits the full interval; local trial diagnostics remain visible.
transactional_algorithm.step_3_event_corrector: Solve one 4-unknown constrained nonlinear problem for [h1,h2,h3,t_event]. The three soil equations are the same conservative implicit dry-step balances from the original committed state over t_event. The fourth equation is q_supply=qcap(h_surface=0,h1). t_event is bounded by the frozen R2B bracket.
transactional_algorithm.event_residual_scaling: Scale the flux complementarity residual by the frozen event-bracket width so all four least-squares residuals have units cm.
transactional_algorithm.step_4_ponded_remainder: From the uncommitted event state with surface storage exactly zero, solve the remaining interval [t_event,t1] in ponded/head mode. Event state and remainder remain part of one outer trial.
transactional_algorithm.step_5_commit: Only if event solve, ponded remainder, face-scope guards and the complete interval water balance all pass may the final state be published once. Any failure rolls back to the original committed state.
transactional_algorithm.warm_start: The full dry predictor may seed the event corrector numerically, but all event residuals are evaluated from the original committed physical state.

candidate_reference_policy.candidate_internal_faces: existing qualified bounded RossFast C1R/R3 face family
candidate_reference_policy.reference_event_capacity: independent endpoint-aware high-accuracy 5 cm surface-face reference
candidate_reference_policy.ponded_remainder_surface_component: Use the already separately qualified bounded 5 cm surface-face contract in both composed trajectories to isolate event/internal-soil composition; crosscheck accepted candidate and reference final surface fluxes against the independent high-accuracy surface oracle.

solver_policy.nonlinear_method: qualification-only scipy least_squares, same 1e-13 xtol/ftol/gtol and 120 nfev cap as E3G/R1

architecture_checks.3_explicit_data_separation: Committed state, forcing, event diagnostics, numerical scratch and final results remain distinct.
architecture_checks.4_compact_persistent_state: No persistent event-time or event-head copy is added to a column.
architecture_checks.5_scratch_per_worker: Predictor, event corrector and remainder vectors are worker-owned scratch.
architecture_checks.7_transactional_timesteps: Predictor and event state are uncommitted; only the fully accepted composed interval publishes once.
architecture_checks.8_warm_start: Predictor information may seed the corrector but does not redefine the physical start state.
architecture_checks.9_generic_time: t_event is a generic offset inside [t0,t1].
architecture_checks.13_mass_conservation_absolute: Both segments and the whole interval must close without repair.
architecture_checks.20_alternative_soil_water_solvers: The boundary event consumes generic soil-step and surface-face contracts rather than HeadCalc internals.
architecture_checks.23_physics_solver_policy_separated: Complementarity and storage are physical; event-corrector method/tolerances are numerical policy.
architecture_checks.24_predictable_runtime: The candidate uses a fixed three-trajectory composition, not an unbounded retry/bisection loop.
architecture_checks.25_reference_mode: Independent full-accuracy event/internal-soil references remain available.
architecture_checks.26_diagnostics_runtime: Predictor reason, bracket, t_event, residuals, solver counts and balance terms are explicit.

hard_nonclaims: No production runtime cost qualification; the three-trajectory candidate is a restricted qualification composition.
No top soil-node h=0 or positive-head state qualification.
No runoff with real soil state.
No response tangent across the boundary switch.
No MultiSWAP, MODFLOW or groundwater admission.
